curated-fs-telma-gf-kufam: Kufam runs one tube-like stroke through every letter, like neon. Telma's flowing, pen-written heading swells and thins, and that shimmer against the uniform wire below is the pair's best trick, good for brief bursts of text.
curated-fs-telma-gf-league-gothic: Tall and tightly packed, League Gothic reads like a column of fence posts. Telma's open, flowing script gives it room to breathe, so the heading drifts above the cramped sans, built for brief reading.
curated-fs-telma-gf-liter: Liter keeps every stroke, the g included, at a single weight. Liter's tall lowercase stands steady under Telma's shaded, flowing heading (a fit for an ex libris bookplate, maybe), best for brief spells of text.
curated-fs-telma-gf-miriam-libre: Wire-thin strokes, cast-iron stature: that's Miriam Libre. Telma's script bowls thin gracefully above, a gentle foil for the rod-stock sameness of horizontals and verticals, made for brief reading.
curated-fs-telma-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One hangs big-eyed letters like clothespins on a line. Telma's mild contrast sets the tone, and once text runs on, the unvarying stroke stays steady, though it's made for brief reading, say, a desk nameplate.
curated-fs-telma-gf-momo-signature: Momo Signature lets its lowercase rival the capitals in height. Telma's open letterforms flow above while the body keeps its crimped, closed-in gaps, a contrast that stays pleasant in tiny portions.
curated-fs-telma-gf-mukta-vaani: Contemporary and high-waisted, Mukta Vaani barely modulates any stroke. Under Telma's subtly modulated script, the body text moves along quite smoothly, though it is happiest in modest portions of text.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew: Bookish and lightly engraved, Noto Rashi Hebrew reads like brass lettering, with short ascender stems on bodies that stand tall. Telma adds flowing script above, best for brief stretches.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Crisp and spacious, Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous gaps between curve ends and stems, with little height difference between cases. Telma's in-between shading keeps the text gentle, if taken sparingly.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan reads clean and modern, with a pronounced x-height. Beside Telma's felt-marker swelling, text runs on crisply, though it's made for brief reading, a business card for instance.
